summary: SAML RelayState truncated by ingress proxy breaks tenant linking and admin impersonation in private VPC
description:
Issue summary:
Customer Moneta reports intermittent 403s and admin-console SSO loops when attempting to impersonate tenant admins via SAML single sign-on in their private VPC deployment. The problem started after an ingress-proxy upgrade performed by the customer's infra team on 2026-03-08.

Impact:
- Admins cannot complete SSO login flows to reach the Redwood Console (console shows SSO redirect loop).
- Attempts to impersonate tenant users via the admin API return 403 with 'tenant resolution failed' in audit logs.
- Affects all tenants behind the customer's private deployment; ~100 admin users impacted during business hours.

Environment:
- Private control plane + on-prem edge ingress (customer-managed Edge Proxy v2.2.0 -> upgraded to v2.2.1 by customer).
- Redwood control plane in prod/us-west-2.
- RBAC and tenant linking configured to use SAML RelayState to carry tenant_id and impersonation tags.

Steps to reproduce (customer):
1) Navigate to /auth/saml/login?RelayState=<long-encoded-payload-with-tenant>
2) Complete SAML login at idp.moneta.com
3) IdP posts SAMLResponse + RelayState back to ingress at /auth/saml/callback
4) Observe redirect loop or landing at root with missing tenant context; admin impersonation fails with 403 when calling /admin/impersonate

Expected behavior:
- RelayState is preserved intact through the ingress and posted to our SAML callback endpoint; tenant linking resolves and admin console loads with tenant context.

Actual behavior:
- RelayState is truncated to ~256 characters (customer's payload is ~900 chars after base64+url-encoding). Truncation removes tenant metadata, causing tenant resolution to fall back to default/unknown and RBAC denies admin impersonation.

Relevant logs (excerpts provided by customer):
- ingress-proxy access log: POST /auth/saml/callback 302 - "RelayState=eyJ0ZW5hbnQiOiAi...<TRUNC>"
- console audit log: "tenant_resolution: missing_relaystate, action: impersonate, status: denied, reason: tenant_lookup_failed"
- idp response: SAMLResponse successfully issued, RelayState intact on IdP side.

Notes from initial triage:
- Customer reproduced the issue by downgrading ingress to v2.1.8 and observed RelayState preserved.
- The customer's ingress v2.2.1 is configured with an annotation 'proxy.buffer.max-param-size' set to 256KB, but we've seen a bug where URL param normalization applies a legacy 256-char limit when header rewriting is enabled.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-09 09:20 - Support (Leah): Confirmed symptom and collected ingress access logs and SAMLResponse samples from customer.

2026-03-09 11:45 - SRE (Diego): Replayed SAML flow against a staging edge proxy with same config; observed RelayState truncated to 256 chars when header 'x-forwarded-proto' was normalized by route plugin.

2026-03-09 14:10 - Eng (Arjun): Looked into edge-proxy request parser; discovered a regression in v2.2.x where query-param normalization that dedups CRLF incorrectly applies old 'paramMaxLength' constant to POST body-referred RelayState handling.
2026-03-10 08:33 - Customer infra: Provided packet captures showing original POST body contained full RelayState; truncation happened before handoff to backend.
comments: Leah Morales (2026-03-09): Thank you for the report, Moneta. We reproduced locally in a minimal environment; can you provide the exact ingress annotations you applied during the upgrade?

Moneta SRE - jamie.lewis@moneta.com (2026-03-09): Provided ingress annotations and confirmed they enabled header-rewrite and strict-params=true. They also confirmed downgrade to v2.1.8 restores behavior.

Diego Rivera (2026-03-09): I can reproduce with header-rewrite enabled. Creating INT ticket for edge-proxy team to track the regression. Marking probable cause as parameter normalization regression in 2.2.x.

Arjun Patel (2026-03-10): Patch proposed in edge-proxy repo to restore RelayState passthrough; PR reference added. We recommend customer to rollback to v2.1.8 or apply temporary ingress annotation 'proxy.relaystate-preserve=true' if supported by their vendor.
temporary_workaround: Customer rolled back their ingress to v2.1.8 which restored RelayState preservation. As an alternative, they can set 'proxy.relaystate-preserve=true' on routes (edge-proxy experimental) to bypass normalization until a patch is released.
resolution:
Workaround applied by customer: rollback to edge-proxy v2.1.8 in prod. Engineering shipped hotfix to edge-proxy (v2.2.2) that removes legacy param-length clamp for POST-bound RelayState and adds an opt-in strict-mode flag. Patch PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge-proxy/pull/1297.

Follow-ups:
- (ENG) Backport hotfix to stable-2.2 branch and publish advisory.
- (SUPPORT) Send step-by-step rollback/upgrade note to Moneta and confirm post-upgrade validation plan.
- (SEC/COMMS) Draft customer-facing advisory about RelayState handling changes for private deployments.

Ticket status: awaiting customer confirmation on upgrade to v2.2.2; will move to Resolved after validation window (72h) closes.
